General-content county map showing physical relief, townships, buildings in rural areas, and householders' names in rural areas; also shows householders' names in borough and village insets.

General-content county map showing physical relief, townships, buildings in rural areas, and householders' names in rural areas; also shows householders' names in borough and village insets. Relief shown by shading, hachures, and form lines. Former wall map. Originally printed on western/eastern sheets (now conjoined and mounted on cloth backing). LC copy imperfect: Lightly stained, missing torn-away section at left center (including small portion of cartographic content), each sheet sectioned to 3 panels to enable folding, annotated in red ink/lead pencil. Includes 2 borough business directories, 4 street-map insets (boroughs of Bellefonte/Milesburg/Philipsburg/Unionville), 17 village insets, distance table, and ill. of county court-house.
